cl_nic_pouches: A checker notes that 'may be less harmful than tobacco' (the review authors' view) could read as a nudge to switch.
cl_nic_nrt_forms: A trial result that names products (a nicotine patch plus gum or similar): a reader could take it as advice to combine them.
cl_nic_nrt_harms: One patch trial in people with heart disease found no more serious problems: a reader could take it as reassurance.
cl_nic_vapes_stopping: A trial result that names a product (vapes did better than patches or gum): a reader could take it as advice to vape to quit.
cl_nic_vapes_stopping_support: A trial result that names a product (people given a vape quit more often): a reader could take it as advice to get one.
cl_nic_exercise_cravings: A reader could take this as a tip to walk off cravings.
cl_nic_oral_nrt_withdrawal: It names nicotine gum and similar products with a benefit: a reader could take it as advice to use them.
cl_can_smoked_vs_vaped: It compares two ways of taking cannabis on how strong the effect felt (vaped felt stronger at the lower amount): a reader could take it as a way to a stronger effect.
cl_can_vaped_lungs: Symptoms easing after people switched to a vaporizer (an uncontrolled, second-hand report) could read as advice to switch.
cl_can_edibles: Eating acts more slowly, and some people took more than they meant before they felt it: a reader could take it as advice on waiting.
cl_can_concentrates: Twice the blood THC with concentrates, but people did not feel more intoxicated: a reader could take it as reassurance.
cl_mdma_preloading_practices: It lists what people said they did (water, taking less, breaks, 5-HTP or vitamins before or after): a reader could take these as tips. Nobody tested whether they help.
cl_alc_protective_strategies: Students drank more on days they had a designated driver: a reader could take that as a reason to skip one (the review's author thinks people plan a ride home for heavy nights).
cl_opi_loperamide_withdrawal: It names a medicine sold without prescription that people use for withdrawal. The heart problems these same people had are in the separate answer on loperamide and the heart, already on the site.
cl_xc_coping_during: Cannabis, alcohol and another drug are among what people said helped during a hard trip (said to be untested): a reader could take it as a tip.
cl_pop_eye_stopping: 'Nobody knows' whether stopping helps could be read as no reason to stop poppers after eye damage; the lines say that almost everyone treated was told to stop.
cl_alc_water_dehydration: A 2026 trial of water drunk while drinking came after the review this answer rests on; it is in the answer on water and hangovers that you approved.
cl_opi_constipation_otc_laxatives: The authors' untested view that prescription laxatives may not beat shop ones could read as advice.
